message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts.

Facts: From May to Dec 2007, defendant Wang M accused of fraud: He pretended to be able to purchase a house in Tangshan city at discount, and using purchase of garage, house registration etc, he defrauded victim Hong for total 115,000 RMB. Then when victim wanted to report to police, Wang filed false report claiming victim defrauded him of 640,000 RMB, and had friend He give false testimony, intending to make victim criminally liable.

Thus crimes: Fraud (诈骗) for defrauding victim. Also false reporting and making false statements to police, possibly "伪证罪" (providing false testimony) or "诬告陷害罪" (false accusation). The fact says he reported to police claiming victim defrauded him, and friend gave false testimony, intending to cause victim to be criminally pursued. That is "诬告陷害罪" (false accusation and framing). In Chinese criminal law, "诬告陷害罪" is for false accusation. Also "伪证罪" is for giving false testimony. The defendant himself made false report, which is false accusation. So likely charge: 诈骗罪; 诬告陷害罪.

Check examples: In earlier similar case, they used "诈骗;聚众扰乱公共场所秩序、交通秩序" for a case of fraud plus disturbance. So they separate charges.

Thus answer: 诈骗;诬告陷害
